verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss provides a first-party REST API with Bash/PHP examples, so it can be driven headlessly from scripts, including triggering Automations and Action Plans without the UI. It offers no documented CLI, CI integration guidance, or published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404). missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation or examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
You can find Bash and PHP examples [here](https://github.com/FollowUpBoss/fub-api-examples)
Manually trigger an Automation for a specified Person.
